name: algebraic_domain_obfuscation
description: Replaced the direct inequality constraint with a quadratic form modulo 3 ($s_u^2 + s_v^2 + s_u s_v \not\equiv 0 \pmod 3$) that is mathematically equivalent to $s_u \neq s_v$ over the domain {1, 2, 3}. This hides the underlying graph coloring structure, preventing the model from recognizing the problem and applying the degree-descending and Minimum Remaining Values (MRV) heuristics necessary to pass the time limit with backtracking on dense instances.
